# HR Market Size & Data Standards

| Indicator | Value and scope | Interpretation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| China HCM SaaS | IDC estimated approximately USD 720 million in 2024, up 12.4%, and forecast more than USD 1.55 billion by 2029 with CAGR above 16.4%. | Research estimate for HCM SaaS; retain publisher, date and methodology. |
| Global HCM software | Gartner estimated approximately USD 36.3 billion in 2024, up about 13%, and expected more than USD 51 billion by 2028. | Global HCM software scope; not directly comparable with China SaaS figures. |
| Manufacturing | 2025 China industrial value added was approximately RMB 41.68 trillion; manufacturing value added grew 6.4%. | Economic-scale proxy for the customer pool. |
| Retail and catering | 2025 retail sales were approximately RMB 50.12 trillion and catering revenue RMB 5.80 trillion. | Proxy for distributed-workforce demand, not HR software TAM. |
| Logistics and services | 2025 transport/storage/post value added was about RMB 6.21 trillion; software revenue was about RMB 15.48 trillion. | Keep each indicator’s industry and statistical scope separate. |
